stv-8178.d: A gentle animated short set on London's Oxford Street, where an unlikely guardian watches over a homeless man sleeping rough. Homelessness and mental illness are the themes; the tone is warm and nothing is graphic.

stv-8180.d: A documentary short built around one family's keepsake: a medallion. Through it, a mother recounts surviving Ethiopia's Red Terror — seized as a schoolgirl, she spent years in a prison camp and endured torture during a period when tens of thousands were executed. Told in her own testimony with archival footage — heavy history, carried by memory rather than spectacle.
